def factor_upper_shadow_vol(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    vol = df_copy["volume"]
    upper_shadow = high - np.maximum(open_, close)
    vol_med = vol.rolling(20, min_periods=1).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_norm = vol / vol_med
    base_signal = (upper_shadow * vol_norm).fillna(0.0)
    smoothed_base = base_signal.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    df_copy["factor_upper_shadow_vol"] = smoothed_base
    return df_copy["factor_upper_shadow_vol"]
description: Mutation simplifies the parent crossover by removing the negative return skewness modulation, retaining only the volume-weighted upper shadow with EMA smoothing. The core economic mechanism is distribution selling pressure: long upper shadows on heavy volume indicate bearish conviction. Removing skew reduces noise and may improve IC stability while preserving the elite parent's RankIC and ICIR strength. This ablation targets the bottleneck of potential overfitting from the auxiliary skew signal.
